data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin maria, meaning 'bitter sea', which could be a reference to the sea of sorrows Mary endured during her son's crucifixion. In Christian tradition, Marie is a feminine form of Marius, and it is often associated with the Virgin Mary. The name Marie carries the meaning “Bitter Sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Marie usually hope their child will grow to embody bitter sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marie total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
